author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
For those who complain AI uses lots of energy, have you ever considered this? 

High income humans with BS jobs are way more energy inefficient than AI.  How much energy would the world save if those humans stopped wasting energy on fancy cars, flying around in business classes, luxury suits and designer fashions?

AI can replace every single BS jobs in the economy since AI is the. ultimate BS machine
